notes.account: Author: recalls having rectified a gross error, linked to ignorance of algebraic topology and homotopy, concerning strongly associative and commutative H-spaces (expressed by equivalence to Ω^iX for arbitrarily large i) and commutative topological groups. This is presented as a former mistaken belief, not a theorem asserted on this page.
Author: explicitly says he remains intrigued by the question of an analogue of the Dold-Puppe tapis for (1/2) simplicial groups, not necessarily commutative, and asks what form it takes.

Author: calls the ens. 1/2 simplicial ↔ ∞-groupoïde yoga an ultimate set-theoretic version of Dold-Puppe, then describes abelian groups in (∞-cat) as the chain complexes in (Ab). These are informal claims; category conventions and any intended equivalence notion are not specified on this isolated page.
Author: proposes determining the groups in (∞-cat), and says he can explain the (1-cat) case. The page breaks during the last word, visibly dévelop-. No continuation was consulted or supplied.

coverage: The whole image (1687 × 2366) was viewed once for layout, then supplied halves a and b once each in sequence. Every physical text line and every agreed word or sign in C/H were read, including accents and absent accents, abbreviations, punctuation, author page number, both paragraph blocks, the complete two-object diagram with both arrowheads, the overwrite beneath groupoïde, quotation shapes and placement, all category notations, the unfinished final word, and the archive foliation. No marginal prose, drawing, separate insertion, other deletion, star label, or intentional underline was found. Six single tight crops were made only for places remaining unresolved after the halves; one crop served two adjacent opening doubts and the connector crop also exposed an adjacent uncertain point. H omits ne and autres, does not transcribe the older overwritten word, changes both diagram endings to plurals, and differs in accents, quotation marks, punctuation, and the final word. Both witnesses omit two small isolated points whose intentional status remains uncertain. No OCR, external source, other page or reader, LaTeX compilation, or delegation was used.
